## R Markdown

This document contains the R analysis of bulk RNA-seq count data from BV2 microglial cells assigned to control (`Con`) or CXCL14-treated (`CXCL14`) groups. The original workflow used HTSeq-style gene count files, DESeq2 for differential expression, Reactome and Gene Ontology for enrichment, and variance-stabilized expression for heatmaps.

```{r}
## 1. Load required packages
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(apeglm)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ReactomePA)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
## 2. Read HTSeq gene-count files
##processed data files found on GEO GSE352519
count_dir <- file.path("data", "BV2_counts")

htseq_to_counts <- function(path.dir, file.suffix = ".counts.txt") {
  files <- sort(Sys.glob(file.path(path.dir, paste0("*", file.suffix))))
  if (length(files) == 0) stop("No matching count files found in: ", path.dir)
  message("Found ", length(files), " count files")

  counts_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    x <- read.table(f, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (ncol(x) != 2) stop("Expected two columns in ", f)
    colnames(x) <- c("gene", "count")
    x
  })

  reference_genes <- counts_list[[1]]$gene
  if (!all(vapply(counts_list, function(x) identical(x$gene, reference_genes), logical(1)))) {
    stop("Gene identifiers are not in identical order across input files")
  }

  count_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(counts_list, function(x) x$count))
  rownames(count_mat) <- reference_genes
  colnames(count_mat) <- sub(paste0("\\Q", file.suffix, "\\E$"), "", basename(files), perl = TRUE)
  count_mat <- count_mat[!grepl("^__", rownames(count_mat)), , drop = FALSE]
  storage.mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
  count_mat
}

count_matrix <- htseq_to_counts(count_dir)
head(count_matrix[, seq_len(min(3, ncol(count_matrix))), drop = FALSE])
```

```{r}
## 3. Differential expression analysis (DESeq2)
#The reference group is `Con`; positive log2 fold changes indicate greater expression in `CXCL14` than `Con`. Genes were retained if their count was at least 10 in at least the size of the smallest experimental group.
condition <- factor(
  vapply(strsplit(colnames(count_matrix), "-"), `[`, character(1), 1),
  levels = c("Con", "CXCL14")
)
if (anyNA(condition)) stop("Sample names must begin with Con- or CXCL14-")
coldata <- data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(count_matrix))
print(table(coldata$condition))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ condition
)
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = "Con")
smallestGroupSize <- min(table(dds$condition))
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= smallestGroupSize
dds <- dds[keep, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "CXCL14", "Con"))
summary(res)
res_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "condition_CXCL14_vs_Con", type = "apeglm")
plotDispEsts(dds)
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition")
```

## 4. Gene identifier annotation

The pipeline mapped mouse Ensembl IDs to gene symbols and Entrez IDs using `org.Mm.eg.db`. 

```{r gene-ids}
res_df <- as.data.frame(res_shrunk)
res_df$symbol <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(res_df), column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"
)
res_df$entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(res_df), column = "ENTREZID",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"
)
res_df <- dplyr::select(res_df, symbol, entrez, everything())
head(res_df)


```

```{r}

## 5. Prepare heatmaps of selected gene signatures
# Heatmaps use variance-stabilized expression values from DESeq2.
# Expression is scaled by row (gene) to obtain Z-scores.
# Samples are ordered by treatment condition without clustering.

mat_all <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vsd)

plot_bv2_heatmap <- function(selected_symbols, plot_title) {

  # Map mouse gene symbols to Ensembl gene identifiers
  sym2ens <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = selected_symbols,
    column = "ENSEMBL",
    keytype = "SYMBOL",
    multiVals = "first"
  )

  # Retain genes present in the expression matrix
  keep_syms <- names(sym2ens)[
    !is.na(sym2ens) & sym2ens %in% rownames(mat_all)
  ]
  sym2ens <- sym2ens[keep_syms]

  missing_syms <- setdiff(selected_symbols, keep_syms)
  if (length(missing_syms) > 0) {
    message("Genes not found: ", paste(missing_syms, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Extract expression values in the specified gene order
  mat <- mat_all[unname(sym2ens), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(mat) <- names(sym2ens)

  # Order samples: Control followed by CXCL14
  sample_order <- order(dds$condition)
  mat <- mat[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]
  cond <- dds$condition[sample_order]

  # Rename columns for visualization
  colnames(mat) <- paste0(
    cond, "-",
    ave(as.character(cond), cond, FUN = seq_along)
  )

  # Sample annotations
  anno_col <- data.frame(Condition = cond)
  rownames(anno_col) <- colnames(mat)

  ann_colors <- list(
    Condition = c(
      "Con" = "#BDBDBD",
      "CXCL14" = "#7FC97F"
    )
  )

  gap_after_con <- sum(cond == "Con")

  # Generate heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat,
    scale = "row",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    gaps_col = gap_after_con,
    annotation_col = anno_col,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    fontsize_row = 18,
    fontsize_col = 10,
    angle_col = 45,
    border_color = NA,
    main = plot_title
  )
}


## 6. Type I interferon signaling heatmap (Main Figure 4C)

ifn_final_candidate <- c(
  "Ifi203", "Ifi205", "Irf3", "Stat2",
  "Mx1", "Mx2", "Oas2", "Oas3",
  "Isg15", "Uba7", "Socs1", "Socs3",
  "Pias2", "Pias3", "Pias4"
)

plot_bv2_heatmap(
  selected_symbols = ifn_final_candidate,
  plot_title = "Type I IFN signature (BV2 bulk RNA-seq)"
)


## 7. Phagocytosis heatmap (Supplementary Figure S5A)

phago_early_revised <- c(
  "Mertk", "Syk", "Fgd2", "Arhgef25",
  "Arhgef4", "Arhgap4", "Arhgap27",
  "Arhgap33", "Arhgap39", "Arhgap45",
  "Rab24"
)

plot_bv2_heatmap(
  selected_symbols = phago_early_revised,
  plot_title = "Early phagocytic priming signature (BV2, 2h CXCL14)"
)




```
